method: Manual browser interaction through CUA Playwright on the local Vite app

scenarios.name: mesh-to-card
scenarios.evidence: Selecting right soleus changed URL/card to HA-M-000002; selecting lateral gastrocnemius head changed URL/card to HA-P-000001.

scenarios.name: mesh-without-pilot-card
scenarios.evidence: Selecting a bone mesh changed mesh selection only; no muscle/part card or ID was fabricated.

scenarios.name: hide-and-picking
scenarios.evidence: After tibia was hidden, a canvas pick at the same location selected the visible mesh behind it; hidden tibia was not selected.

scenarios.name: transparent-and-picking
scenarios.evidence: After soleus was made transparent, a canvas pick passed through it to an opaque underlying mesh.

scenarios.name: restore-and-isolation
scenarios.evidence: Restore all cleared hidden/transparent states; isolate marked non-selected rows as excluded and toggling isolation off restored them.

scenarios.name: camera-and-framing
scenarios.evidence: Front, back and right-lateral presets, whole model, surrounding view, and selected-structure zoom were each activated in the browser; screenshots showed camera/framing changes.
